mapper.sql: FROM dish d INNER JOIN merchant m ON m.id = d.merchant_id INNER JOIN stall s ON s.id = d.stall_id INNER JOIN canteen c ON c.id = d.canteen_id LEFT JOIN category cg ON cg.id = d.category_id
mapper.select:
SELECT d.id, d.merchant_id AS merchantId, d.canteen_id AS canteenId, d.stall_id AS stallId, d.name, d.description, d.price, d.category_id AS categoryId, cg.name AS categoryName, d.average_score AS score, d.status, d.view_count AS viewCount, d.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, d.review_count AS commentCount
ORDER BY d.average_score DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT mr.recommend_reason FROM merchant_recommendation mr WHERE mr.dish_id = #{dishId} AND mr.status = 'ACTIVE' AND mr.start_time <= NOW() AND mr.end_time >= NOW() ORDER BY mr.is_top DESC, mr.start_time DESC, mr.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO dish_image (dish_id, image_url, sort_order, is_cover) VALUES
(#{dishId}, #{image}, #{index}, CASE WHEN #{index} = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

INSERT INTO lottery_pool ( source_type, source_id, merchant_id, canteen_id, stall_id, category_id, title, price, score, cover_image_url, recommend_reason, weight, status ) SELECT 'DISH', d.id, d.merchant_id, d.canteen_id, d.stall_id, d.category_id, d.name, d.price, d.average_score, d.cover_image_url, NULL, 100, CASE WHEN d.is_join_lottery = 1 AND d.status IN ('ON_SALE', 'SOLD_OUT') THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'INACTIVE' END FROM dish d WHERE d.id = #{dishId} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE merchant_id = VALUES(merchant_id), canteen_id = VALUES(canteen_id), stall_id = VALUES(stall_id), category_id = VALUES(category_id), title = VALUES(title), price = VALUES(price), score = VALUES(score), cover_image_url = VALUES(cover_image_url), status = VALUES(status), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE lottery_pool SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE source_type = 'DISH' AND source_id = #{dishId}
